name: Illinois

notes: The 1% state grocery tax ended January 1, 2026. Cities and counties may impose a 1% local grocery tax by ordinance, and the RTA (Cook and collar counties) and Metro East district taxes on groceries continue. Home-rule sales taxes do not apply to groceries.
Motor fuel is subject to the state sales tax (6.25%) and to local sales taxes.
Many Illinois places add local restaurant or food-and-beverage taxes (Chicago 0.5%); see the local rate tables.
Tobacco is assumed taxed at the general rate (excise taxes left out); not verified state by state.
